page.overview:
Who is Matti?

Matti is a minor character in Cars. He is a blue 1992 Delbert Advocate and also Kori Turbowitz's producer.

"Matti is the producer of the number one radio talk show in the bay area, hosted by top reporter Kori Turbowitz. Matti goes out in the field with Kori everywhere, and together the two are an unstoppable team."

Matti is seen asking Lightning McQueen if he had been in rehab before Mack and the media arrived in Radiator Springs to get him to the Los Angeles International Speedway.
